title: Creature head variations

creator_feedback.scope: Body Plans BP1–BP3; selected designs receive head variations
general: The body-plan exploration is closer, but not finished.
The heads lean too heavily on lizard shapes. Add mammalian and other skull, jaw, nose and ear structures while retaining some lizard/snake options.
Needlehip's lizard-like face, fur and whip tail illustrate an interesting combination, not a universal template.
Preserve the selected body plans and coverings while exploring restrained head variation.

rejected.name: Siltdrum
rejected.reason: Creator dislikes its fat, ugly appearance; do not use this take as a reference.

creator_feedback.mixed_sheet_policy: No sheet is accepted or rejected wholesale. Keep the composite source sheets because they contain liked takes; the disliked BP1-4 has no separate image file to delete. Reference only the explicitly selected cells.

workflow: Three proposed head options per selected creature, each shown as portrait and corresponding full-body view. Body plans and coverings retained; head picks precede final references or scenes.
